machine.type: continuous-extrusion blow molder per the node design block (Precious Plastic class; AQS-EQP-MFG-001; A-M-285): 316L melt path (extruder barrel, extrusion head, downward die) per duty section 3, the three drive groups as purchased envelopes per plan rule 6 with the node ratings (extruder 2.2 kW, clamp 0.75 kW BLOW-CLAMP-01, air 0.75 kW BLOW-AIR-01), and the mold tool envelope (BLOW-MOLD-TOOL-01) between the platens
machine.process: node figures: 2.8 kg/h at 3.0 h/d on the 8.407 kg/d wax feed (C11-C18 to the mold); products to MFG_SHOP (IA-BLOW-OUT); scrap to OIL_FRAC (node design lines)
machine.mold_hold: the article geometry is not named on the node, so the mold set is an envelope and the mold detail is a named hold (WORK_ORDER W12)
machine.material_basis: duty section 3: 316L where the stream is wet (the wax melt path); CA 0 mm (AQS-STD-001); frame and dry groups carbon steel
machine.guard: four-post guard frame (40 x 40 posts, top rails) on the base plate pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); anchors in fasteners.csv

N1.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; 50 datum is the schedule placeholder

N2.note: vent flush at the envelope top; the schedule datum 800 mm predates the 1600 box (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N3.note: atmospheric hose joint per duty section 4; solids row is a non-piped transfer: drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4)

N4.note: atmospheric hose joint per duty section 4; solids row is a non-piped transfer: drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric hose joints per duty section 4; the N3/N4 solids rows are non-piped transfers drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4); the N2 vent datum 800 predates the 1600 box (hold, W12); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
